hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market pools implementing VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) dynamic fees. Requires a backend-signed sigma parameter per swap; fees are computed as e^[λ*(Δx/L)*σ]-1 and captured via BeforeSwapDelta, then distributed to share token holders via a YieldDistributor rather than to LPs.
